summary: Glucotrack, Inc. filed Amendment No. 1 to its Form 8-K to provide required financial statements and pro forma information for its reverse merger with Lokahi Therapeutics Inc., previously reported under Item 2.01. The amendment includes audited and unaudited Lokahi financials and pro forma combined statements, but does not disclose deal terms such as price or premium. The transaction closed around July 9, 2026. Observers should review the original 8-K for structural details and monitor integration risk or potential dilution.
